title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-28

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording with mixed sound quality but a solid 1973 show highlighted by an epic Mountain Jam and standout Here Comes Sunshine.
ai_review.review: The Watkins Glen performance is praised for its strong setlist, historic vibe, and especially the soaring Mountain Jam and crisp Here Comes Sunshine.  The source is a hybrid soundboard/audience matrix that suffers from occasional static, dig‑noise and spliced audience cuts, requiring some EQ work, but it remains listenable.  Overall fans view the show as a “gem” of ’73 despite its technical quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.3; most comments praise the musical performance while noting consistent but manageable recording flaws, leading to a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix includes soundboard core with audience splices; distortion/static in Truckin', dig‑noise in He's Gone/Truckin', and occasional audience cuts that need EQ adjustment, but overall the audio is listenable.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid, historically significant set with a well‑balanced first set and a jam‑heavy second set; encore noted as sweet.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his improvisational work on Mountain Jam ("taking on Duane") and generally strong guitar performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboards receive high marks; reviewers note a second keyboardist (likely Garth Hudson) during Around & Around segment.
